AcDeath.label: Air Conditioner Breakdown
AcDeath.description: Breaks the air conditioner and spawns a separate damaged unit in its place.

AcDeathFreeze.label: Air Conditioner Freeze
AcDeathFreeze.description: Runs the freeze variant of the air conditioner destruction callback and leaves a damaged unit behind. The destruction freeze's target rules are unverified.

AcMalfunction.label: Air Conditioner Malfunction
AcMalfunction.description: Periodically vents a warning and then briefly freezes a nearby hero.

ArcWeldingMelee.label: Arc Welder Strike
ArcWeldingMelee.description: Strikes a nearby target with an arc welder, dealing physical damage.

BabyToss.label: Mortar Lob
BabyToss.description: Lobs a fireball in a high arc that damages targets around its impact point.

BeastPetPassive.label: Beast Companion Revival
BeastPetPassive.description: Checks whether the beast companion can revive its owner, with a separate use during Overdrive.

BeastSentinelPetAttack.label: Beast Companion Strike
BeastSentinelPetAttack.description: Strikes an enemy in melee on behalf of the Beast Sentinel's owner.

BeastSentinelPetRespawn.label: Beast Companion Respawn
BeastSentinelPetRespawn.description: Handles the Beast Sentinel companion's respawn.

Bite.label: Bite
Bite.description: Bites a target within melee reach.

BoomerCharge.label: Boomer Rush
BoomerCharge.description: Charges toward the target to close into striking range.

Burrow.label: Burrow

BurstShot.label: Fireball Burst
BurstShot.description: Fires a rapid sequence of fireballs at the target.

CastMarkOfZelem.label: Mark of Zelem
CastMarkOfZelem.description: Marks a hero for Polaris's follow-up attack.

CastScopeBurn.label: Scope Burn
CastScopeBurn.description: Applies a burn that damages the target over time.

CastScopeDebuff.label: Scope Energy Vulnerability
CastScopeDebuff.description: Makes the target take more energy damage. The increase depends on Scope's rank.

CastScopeThorns.label: Scope Thorns
CastScopeThorns.description: Grants another allied creature a temporary effect that returns flat energy damage to melee attackers.

CastShadowCurse.label: Shadow Curse
CastShadowCurse.description: Applies a curse that deals Supernatural energy damage over time.

CastShadowPanic.label: Shadow Panic
CastShadowPanic.description: Frightens heroes caught in the shadow effect.

CastZelemHasteBuff.label: Raytheoid Haste
CastZelemHasteBuff.description: Grants the Haster a temporary buff to movement and attack speed and reduces its cooldowns.

ChainLightning.label: Chain Lightning
ChainLightning.description: Uses the Cryos melee creature's lightning attack. Its jump behavior is unverified in build 103.

ChainLightningBolt.label: Lightning Sweep
ChainLightningBolt.description: Sweeps lightning across an area in front of the caster.

ChannelLightningCage.label: Lightning Cage
ChannelLightningCage.description: Channels a cage that holds the targeted hero until the effect ends.

CircleTarget.label: Circle Target
CircleTarget.description: Moves around the target to maintain a circling path while in combat.

CitadelBasicGunner_Shot.label: Gunner Shot
CitadelBasicGunner_Shot.description: Fires a single projectile at the target.

CitadelBasicRanged_Bolt.label: Citadel Bolt
CitadelBasicRanged_Bolt.description: Fires a ranged energy bolt at the target.

CitadelBasicShield_Melee.label: Shield Sweep
CitadelBasicShield_Melee.description: Swings the shield in a cone at close range.

CitadelBasicShield_Passive.label: Directional Shield
CitadelBasicShield_Passive.description: Protects the shield carrier against attacks from the direction it is facing.

CitadelBossLaunch.label: Minion Launch
CitadelBossLaunch.description: Launches reinforcements during the Citadel boss encounter.

CitadelBossMissile.label: Arcturus Missile
CitadelBossMissile.description: Launches a missile that deals area damage on impact.

CitadelBossPassive.label: Citadel Boss Passive
CitadelBossPassive.description: Runs the Citadel boss's passive encounter logic. Individual effects of this hook are unverified in build 103.

CitadelChargeFriend.label: Charge Ally
CitadelChargeFriend.description: Transfers a charge to a nearby ally so that it can use its charged attack.

CitadelDischarge.label: Citadel Discharge
CitadelDischarge.description: Releases the caster's stored charge in an attack.

CitadelGrenadeRoll.label: Rolling Grenade
CitadelGrenadeRoll.description: Rolls a grenade toward the target, where it detonates.

CitadelMinionMelee_Flamethrower.label: Flamethrower
CitadelMinionMelee_Flamethrower.description: Projects fire in a cone in front of the caster.

CitadelMinionSuicide_Suicide.label: Self-Destruct
CitadelMinionSuicide_Suicide.description: Detonates the caster to damage nearby targets.

CitadelPlasmaAura.label: Plasma Pool
CitadelPlasmaAura.description: Deals repeated damage to targets standing in the plasma pool.

CitadelPlasmaBurn.label: Plasma Burn
CitadelPlasmaBurn.description: Deals damage over time to targets burned by plasma.

CitadelSpecialOne_BurningDOT.label: Burn
CitadelSpecialOne_BurningDOT.description: Applies a burn that damages the target over time.

CitadelSpecialOne_EnergyVulnerable.label: Energy Vulnerability
CitadelSpecialOne_EnergyVulnerable.description: Makes the target more vulnerable to energy damage.

CitadelSpecialOne_FireThorns.label: Fire Thorns
CitadelSpecialOne_FireThorns.description: Grants a friendly creature, including the caster, a buff that reflects a small share of incoming melee damage.

CitadelSpecialThree_LaserZone.label: Laser Zone
CitadelSpecialThree_LaserZone.description: Sweeps a laser through the area in front of the caster.

CitadelSpecialThree_LaserZoneControllerM.label: Laser Zone Controller
CitadelSpecialThree_LaserZoneControllerM.description: Runs the controller for the laser zone. Its exact passive timing is unverified in build 103.

CitadelSpecialTwo_HomingStun.label: Homing Stun Bolt
CitadelSpecialTwo_HomingStun.description: Fires a homing projectile that stuns its target on impact.

CitadelSpecialTwo_Melee.label: Citadel Melee Strike
CitadelSpecialTwo_Melee.description: Strikes the target at close range.

CitadelSpecialTwo_SilenceAura.label: Silence Aura
CitadelSpecialTwo_SilenceAura.description: Applies silence to heroes within the aura.

CitadelSpecificFour_Bolt.label: Citadel Energy Bolt
CitadelSpecificFour_Bolt.description: Fires an energy projectile at the target.

CitadelSpecificFour_Position.label: Firing Position
CitadelSpecificFour_Position.description: Repositions the caster for its ranged attack.

CitadelSpecificTwo_MeleeTaunt.label: Taunting Strike
CitadelSpecificTwo_MeleeTaunt.description: Strikes a target in melee and taunts it.

Consume.label: Devour Minion

ConsumeCorpse.label: Corpse Growth
ConsumeCorpse.description: Feeds on a nearby corpse to grow larger and stronger.

CryosBasicCharge.label: Cryos Rush
CryosBasicCharge.description: Rushes toward the target to close into headbutt range.

CryosBasicChargeHeadbutt.label: Headbutt
CryosBasicChargeHeadbutt.description: Strikes the target with a headbutt at close range.

CryosBasicFieryMelee.label: Fiery Strike
CryosBasicFieryMelee.description: Strikes a nearby target and applies a burn.

CryosBasicFireWave.label: Fire Wave
CryosBasicFireWave.description: Sends a wave of fire toward the target.

CryosBasicLightningMelee.label: Lightning Strike
CryosBasicLightningMelee.description: Strikes a nearby target with lightning.

CryosBasicLightningRanged.label: Lightning Cone
CryosBasicLightningRanged.description: Projects lightning at targets in a cone.

CryosBasicPassiveModifier.label: Fiery Passive
CryosBasicPassiveModifier.description: Runs the Fiery creature's passive modifier. Its individual effects are unverified in build 103.

CryosBossMelee.label: Merak Strike
CryosBossMelee.description: Strikes a target within Merak's melee reach.

CryosBossPassive.description: Runs Merak's passive encounter logic, including its response to damage for spawning reinforcements.

CryosElementalSpecialThree.label: Cryos Elemental Shot
CryosElementalSpecialThree.description: Fires the Cryos elemental's ranged projectile.

CryosGeyserDeath.label: Geyser Unseal

CryosGeyserPassive.label: Geyser Eruption
CryosGeyserPassive.description: Warns before sending up a spout that damages targets in the eruption area.

CryosPlasmaAddPassive.label: Plasma Add Passive
CryosPlasmaAddPassive.description: Runs the Cryos Plasma Add's passive callback. Its individual effects are unverified in build 103.

CryosPoisonMelee.label: Poison Strike
CryosPoisonMelee.description: Strikes the target in melee and applies poison.

DartingAttack.label: Darting Rush
DartingAttack.description: Darts toward the target in a quick rush.

DeathDetonate.label: Death Blast
DeathDetonate.description: Explodes on death and damages nearby targets.

Destructible.label: Destruction Setup
Destructible.description: Runs the destructible object's passive setup. Its effects depend on the object using it.

DirectHeal.label: Self Heal
DirectHeal.description: Restores some of the caster’s own health after it takes enough damage.

DiseaseCone.label: Disease Cone
DiseaseCone.description: Projects a cone of disease in front of the caster.

DrainerDeathDetonate.label: Drainer Death Blast
DrainerDeathDetonate.description: Explodes when the Drainer dies, damaging nearby targets.

DrainerMelee.label: Drainer Strike
DrainerMelee.description: Strikes a nearby target when the Drainer is in melee range.

EggPoison.label: Egg Poison

EnemyPortalPassive.label: Enemy Portal Passive
EnemyPortalPassive.description: Runs the enemy portal's passive encounter logic. Its individual effects are unverified in build 103.

ExplodingEggDeath.label: Egg Burst
ExplodingEggDeath.description: Bursts on destruction and can apply delayed poison to nearby creatures.

ExplodingThornDeath.label: Thorn Burst

ExplodingTreeDeath.label: Fear Burst

FactoryLightDeath.label: Factory Light Break

FastSwipe.label: Quick Swipe
FastSwipe.description: Quickly swipes at a target in melee range.

Fireball.label: Fireball

FireElementalPetDeath.label: Fire Elemental Death
FireElementalPetDeath.description: Runs the summoned fire elemental's death callback. Any additional gameplay effects are unverified in build 103.

FireStream.label: Fire Stream

FirstAggro_ActivateRobot.label: Robot Activation
FirstAggro_ActivateRobot.description: Activates the robot and plays its startup sequence when it first engages.

FirstAggro_ActivateSpecialRobot.label: Special Robot Activation
FirstAggro_ActivateSpecialRobot.description: Plays the special robot's startup sequence on first engagement.

FirstAggro_Anim.label: Alert Animation
FirstAggro_Anim.description: Plays the creature's authored animation on first alert.

FirstAggro_Anim_NonFacing.label: Non-Turning Alert

FirstAggro_BeamIn.label: Beam In

FirstAggro_BeamIn_Agent.label: Agent Beam In

FirstAggro_BeamIn_Tutorial.label: Tutorial Beam In

FirstAggro_CitadelBasicMeleeUnburrow.label: Citadel Unburrow
FirstAggro_CitadelBasicMeleeUnburrow.description: Emerges from below when the Citadel melee unit engages.

FirstAggro_CitadelBoss.label: Arcturus Entrance
FirstAggro_CitadelBoss.description: Runs the Citadel boss's encounter introduction.

FirstAggro_CitadelBossMinion.label: Arcturus Minion Entrance
FirstAggro_CitadelBossMinion.description: Runs the Citadel boss minion's entrance sequence.

FirstAggro_CryosBoss_Minion.label: Merak Minion Entrance
FirstAggro_CryosBoss_Minion.description: Reveals and plays the entrance animation for a minion summoned by Merak.

FirstAggro_CryosBossUnburrow.label: Merak Emergence
FirstAggro_CryosBossUnburrow.description: Brings Merak out from underground at the start of the encounter.

FirstAggro_CyberDropIn.label: Cyber Drop-In
FirstAggro_CyberDropIn.description: Drops the Cyber creature into the encounter.

FirstAggro_FaceTarget.label: Face Target
FirstAggro_FaceTarget.description: Turns the creature toward the target on first engagement.

FirstAggro_FlyIn_Zlm.label: Raytheoid Fly In
FirstAggro_FlyIn_Zlm.description: Plays the Zelem flying creature's entrance on first engagement.

FirstAggro_Lowblow.label: Lowblow Entrance
FirstAggro_Lowblow.description: Runs the Citadel unit's Lowblow opening callback. Any effect beyond its entrance is unverified in build 103.

FirstAggro_Roar.label: Opening Roar
FirstAggro_Roar.description: Roars as the creature first engages.

FirstAggro_Roar33.label: Alternate Opening Roar
FirstAggro_Roar33.description: Plays the alternate roar on first engagement.

FirstAggro_ScaldronBoss.label: Corruptor Entrance
FirstAggro_ScaldronBoss.description: Runs the Corruptor's initial encounter introduction.

FirstAggro_ShadowSpawn.label: Shadow Spawn Entrance
FirstAggro_ShadowSpawn.description: Plays the shadow creature's entrance sequence.

FirstAggro_ShadowSpawnLeech.label: Shadow Leech Entrance
FirstAggro_ShadowSpawnLeech.description: Plays the shadow leech's entrance sequence.

FirstAggro_SpawnEater.label: Orcus Entrance
FirstAggro_SpawnEater.description: Runs the Spawn Eater's encounter introduction.

FirstAggro_SpawnEater_Minion.label: Orcus Minion Entrance
FirstAggro_SpawnEater_Minion.description: Reveals a minion spawned by Orcus and plays its entrance.

FirstAggro_SpecialOne.label: Tutorial Special Entrance
FirstAggro_SpecialOne.description: Runs the tutorial special enemy's first engagement sequence.

FirstAggro_SpreadUnburrow.label: Spread Unburrow
FirstAggro_SpreadUnburrow.description: Uses the spread unit's emergence sequence on first engagement.

FirstAggro_Turret.label: Turret Activation
FirstAggro_Turret.description: Plays the turret's activation sequence as it engages.

FirstAggro_VerdanthBasicHealer.label: Rooted Healer Entrance
FirstAggro_VerdanthBasicHealer.description: Plays the Verdanth healer's entrance sequence.

Flee.label: Retreat

FollowOwner.label: Follow Owner

GhostlyBolt.label: Ghostly Bolt
GhostlyBolt.description: Fires a spectral projectile at the target.

GhostlyBoltFlee.label: Rezzer Retreat
GhostlyBoltFlee.description: Moves the Rezzer to a retreat point to regain distance from its target.

GravityOrbPassive.label: Gravity Orb Field
GravityOrbPassive.description: Runs the summoned gravity orb's effect on nearby targets.

GroundSlam.label: Ground Slam

HeadstatueDeath.label: Statue Head Break

HomingSwarm.label: Homing Swarm
HomingSwarm.description: Launches a swarm that homes in on the target.

HurlMagma.label: Magma Lob

InstantNova.label: Instant Nova

InstrumentDeath.description: Deals damage and knocks back nearby targets on the stabilizer's own team when it breaks. The base remains.

InstrumentDeath2.label: Regulator Blast
InstrumentDeath2.description: Deals damage to nearby targets on the regulator's own team when it breaks. The base remains.

InstrumentSlowAura.label: Instrument Slow Field

LightningBallDeath.description: Runs the lightning ball fixture's destruction response.

LightningStorm.label: Lightning Storm

ManaDrain.label: Power Drain

MushroomCryosPoison.label: Cryos Mushroom Poison

MutationAgentPassive.description: Runs the Mutation Agent's passive behavior during its encounter.

nAbility_Bite.label: Bite

nBehavior_FollowStrafe.label: Strafing Pursuit
nBehavior_FollowStrafe.description: Follows the target with lateral movement.

nBehavior_JumpToRangeFrog.label: Frog Reposition

nBehavior_MutationAgent_Wander.label: Mutation Agent Wander

nBehavior_NomadCyberOne_Flee.label: Cyber Agent Retreat
nBehavior_NomadCyberOne_Flee.description: Moves the Cyber Agent away from its threat.

nBehavior_Stroll.description: Moves at a walk while no higher priority action is selected.

nBehavior_Wander.label: Wander
nBehavior_Wander.description: Roams without actively pursuing a target.

NightmareVineRoots.label: Nightmare Roots
NightmareVineRoots.description: Damages targets that remain near the nightmare vine's roots.

NoctBasicMeleeDogDistraction.label: Hound Distraction

NoctFlyerLob.label: Shadow Lob

NoctGhostCharge.label: Ghost Charge

NoctHopperJump.label: Hopper Leap
NoctHopperJump.description: Leaps at the target to attack.

NocturnaBasicHealthDrain.label: Health Drain

NocturnaBasicStealthMelee.label: Shadow Stealth Strike

NocturnaBasicStealthPassive.description: Runs the Nocturna stealth unit's passive stealth logic.

NocturnaEggDeath.label: Nocturna Egg Burst

NocturnaSpecialDriftAura.label: Drift Life Drain
NocturnaSpecialDriftAura.description: Damages nearby targets and heals the Drift creature for the damage it deals.

NocturnaSpecialDriftCharge.description: Rushes toward the target as the Drift creature's charge attack.

NocturnaSpecialHauntLockdown.label: Haunt Lockdown

NocturnaSpecialMunchMelee.label: Munch Sweep

NomadBioSpecialTwoSwipe.description: Swipes at targets in a cone at close range.
